verdict.rationale: Customer.io documents several public APIs. The Track API handles ingress, the Pipelines API handles data in, and the App API sends broadcasts and transactional messages and fetches data. There is also a Postman collection, and a probe confirmed a published OpenAPI spec at /openapi.json covering the Track, App and Design Studio APIs. A CLI wraps these APIs with self-describing JSON endpoints so agents can drive them. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration that the API works well for agent-driven use, and explicit documentation that the API reaches parity with the UI (the 'do anything' claims are made for the MCP server and CLI, not the raw API).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: To send broadcasts, transactional messages, and fetch data (outside of a _data out_ integration), use the App API.
Our Track API provides ways to send real-time customer data to your Customer.io workspace including customer identification and event tracking.
Primary OpenAPI spec for the Track (ingress), App, and Design Studio APIs together, at the conventional path
Every command returns structured JSON, every endpoint is self-describing via `cio schema`
